test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is,

Option (1): AEC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/357bcb240f81e317abf1636fe73dedb151ce5d23308785028c314daaadb050ef.png] 

Option (2): TXV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dae52e7f10f7d3607081858c8a4ac3e9149e553543cf57f9a04de9873537a032.png] 

**Option (3): CHE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00997788330ce7e77f80fbb8e58f76b24bf714c0df3381f74365409539cb8b26.png] 

CHE follows a different pattern (+5, -3).

Option (4): LPN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f73f301a958cccd718b92c304e14e121e7d47c9897abcab878d540eea3888dd2.png] 

The odd letter-cluster is: **CHE**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
